messages:
Ria Patel: Quick one  Friday night idea: DIY nacho bar + karaoke in the common area? Start 7pm, finish ~10. Keep it low-key. Thoughts?
Omar: Love that. I can bring chips + nacho cheese dispenser. :drooling_face: 
Bea: In. Ill bring guac (vegan) and salsa roja.
Ken: Karaoke yes. I have mic + mic stand. Also a Switch with Jackbox if we need filler.
Marta: Can we do soft-start acoustic 6:30-7 for folks who prefer chill?
Ria Patel: Good call. Ill set a 6:30 chill window then ramp to karaoke at 8. RSVP with "Yes/Maybe/No + headcount + food contrib"
Omar: Yes / 1 / chips + cheese.
Bea: Yes / 1 / guac (vegan).
Ken: Yes / +1 / mic + Switch.
Marta: Maybe / 2 / cupcakes.
ops-bot: Note: common area amplified sound after 9pm needs noise approval. Tagging @facilities.
calendar-bot: Event created  "Nachos & Karaoke"  Fri 2025-02-14 19:00  Location: Common Area (alt: Lounge). RSVP in thread.
Ria Patel: I'll grab disposable platters and napkins (compostable). Anyone allergic to dairy/nuts?
Bea: Dairy allergy for one guest, will label guac.
Omar: Ill bring a vegan cheese option too.
Ken: Playlist ideas? Throw songs in thread or DM me.
Marta: :microphone: Ive got a mellow opener list.
Ria Patel: Sweet. If facilities says no late amp, we'll move music to battery speaker and keep mic unplugged after 9.
Omar: Sounds good. See y'all Friday!
